datasheet_identity.title: MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: Family datasheet MM3Z2V0 THRU MM3Z75; all table values are from the MM3Z5V6 row on p. 2.
Zener voltage limits: VZ min 5.2 V, nom 5.6 V, max 6.0 V at IZT = 5 mA. breakdown_voltage records the nominal column.
Maximum zener impedance ZZT = 40 ohm at IZT = 5 mA; knee impedance ZZK = 700 ohm at IZK = 0.5 mA (p. 2, MM3Z5V6 row). The schema has no impedance fields, so these fitting inputs are recorded here.
Typical temperature coefficient at IZTC = 5 mA: -2.0 to +2.5 mV/degC (p. 2, MM3Z5V6 row).
Fig. 1 (zener characteristics up to 12 V) draws only a few unlabeled near-vertical traces; no trace can be attributed to MM3Z5V6 without guessing, so no zener IV curve was extracted.
Fig. 3 is the family-common typical forward characteristic; the Ta = 25 degC trace was digitized and converted from the printed mA axis to SI amperes. The 150/75/0 degC traces were not extracted.

Figs. 4-6 (leakage, capacitance, dynamic impedance) plot family-wide values against nominal zener voltage, not per-part characteristics, and were not extracted; no per-part capacitance table value exists, so capacitance is null.
